Markets.title: Market wrap:  Kotak Mahindra Bank, Power Grid, Maruti Suzuki, Trent top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets ended largely flat on Friday despite Middle East uncertainties, while broader markets outperformed with positive market breadth. Power Grid, HDFC Life, and Kotak Mahindra Bank led the gainers, whereas Maruti Suzuki, Trent, and HCL Tech were the top losers.

Markets.title: India’s PMS Industry AUM rises 2% in July to Rs 44 lakh crore, client base grows 1.3%: APMI
Markets.summary: India’s Portfolio Management Services (PMS) industry grew its assets under management by 2% in July to reach Rs 44.11 lakh crore. During the same month, the total client base expanded by 1.3% to 2.23 lakh, driven by strong inflows and an increasing number of domestic investors and distributors.

Markets.title: Rupee dips on week as oil pangs linger, intervention prevents fall past 96/USD
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee weakened over the week due to rising oil prices and supply concerns. However, central bank intervention and strong foreign currency inflows prevented a sharper decline against the dollar.

Markets.title: Global Market: European shares little changed as bond yields rise and gulf tensions lift oil
Markets.summary: European shares were little changed on Friday, with the STOXX 600 heading for its second consecutive weekly decline. Rising bond yields and higher oil prices, driven by renewed Gulf tensions, weighed on market sentiment and revived inflation concerns.

Markets.title: Multibaggers: 12 stocks with profit margins above 10% for 8 straight quarters. Do you own any?
Markets.summary: A scan of companies with a market cap above Rs 3,000 crore identified 12 stocks that maintained profit margins above 10% for eight straight quarters through June 2026 and delivered gains of 97% to 396% over the past two years. Acutaas Chemicals emerged as the top performer among these stocks.

Markets.title: US Treasury intervention gives Japanese bonds temporary relief as 3% yield looms
Markets.summary: U.S. Treasury intervention temporarily lowered Japanese government bond yields, but analysts warn the 10-year yield could still exceed 3%. Persistent inflation, a weak yen, rising oil prices, and expectations of central bank tightening continue to drive up borrowing costs.

Geo-Political.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
Geo-Political.summary: Thirty pioneer families have moved into a closed West Bank settlement in defiance of international protests and with the backing of the Israeli government. This rapid development has caused significant fear among nearby Palestinian residents.

Geo-Political.title: How much could Trump's 'economic D-Day' hurt Iran?
Geo-Political.summary: Iran has successfully bypassed years of severe economic sanctions imposed by the international community. The potential impact of Donald Trump's proposed "economic D-Day" on Iran's resilient economy remains a central question.

Geo-Political.title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists guilty in national security trial
Geo-Political.summary: Three Hong Kong activists who organized annual vigils for the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown were found guilty of inciting subversion under a national security law. The court ruled that their now-banned group, the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, acted as an agent of foreign forces.

Geo-Political.title: Eight killed in plane crash at remote Alaskan military site, air force says
Geo-Political.summary: A civilian-contracted plane crashed at a remote military radar site in southwest Alaska, killing all eight people on board. The U.S. Air Force stated that the purpose of the aircraft's presence at the location remains unclear.

Geo-Political.title: Pakistan ex-PM Imran Khan back in jail after hospital examination
Geo-Political.summary: Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan has been returned to jail following a medical examination at a hospital. A court had ordered the hospital visit earlier in the week.

Geo-Political.title: Panama Canal to cut number of ships passing through due to El Niño
Geo-Political.summary: Low rainfall caused by the El Niño weather pattern has forced operators to reduce the number of ships passing through the Panama Canal. This decision will limit traffic through the crucial global waterway.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author tested a new strategy for organic visibility and found their WordPress SaaS course recommended as the top result by ChatGPT. This discovery highlights the shift toward AI optimization for generating free web traffic without paid advertising.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to help digital creators stay ahead of the curve in 2025. These essential technologies are revolutionizing the content creation process and making creators' lives easier.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights 10 advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to drive innovation, automate repetitive tasks, and improve workplace productivity. These widely used market solutions cater to various industry applications, including natural language processing.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: The article highlights the top ten AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022 to help users create effective and engaging material. It notes that choosing the right platform can be challenging due to the numerous options on the market.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide explains how to use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money online. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: Private sector growth recovers in August from July’s low as service sector strengthen: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: HSBC's Flash India PMI showed that private sector growth recovered in August from July's low. This economic rebound was driven by strengthening activity in the service sector.

Data & Insights.title: Consumers queue up for premium petrol as E20 concerns refuse to die down
Data & Insights.summary: Consumer concerns about lower mileage and engine damage from ethanol-blended E20 petrol have caused a surge in demand for premium, high-octane fuel. As a result, sales of high-octane petrol jumped from about 4% in March to 12-15%.

Data & Insights.title: India allows duty-free sugar imports as prices surge
Data & Insights.summary: India has reduced its sugar import duty to zero to help lower record-high domestic prices. This decision follows earlier government actions that banned sugar exports and tightened stock holding limits.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth eases to 5.4% in July from 6% in June; iron ore, cement drive expansion
Data & Insights.summary: India's core infrastructure sector growth slowed to 5.4% in July compared to a revised 6% in June. This expansion was primarily driven by iron ore, cement, and electricity.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: India expects a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in fiscal year 2027, but experts warn this may not strengthen the rupee. The currency's actual strength depends on whether the Reserve Bank of India injects these inflows into the market or absorbs them as reserves.

Data & Insights.title: RBI's rate-setting panel hints at future policy tightening if inflation persists
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra stated that the central bank requires more clarity on persistently high prices before taking action. The rate-setting panel indicated that future monetary policy could be tightened if inflation continues.

India.title: Seoul vs Tokyo: Which City Wins On Student Life, Jobs And Affordability
India.summary: Seoul and Tokyo offer distinct experiences for students, differing in student life, job opportunities, and affordability. Choosing between the two cities depends on individual priorities and personal preferences.

India.title: Bihar Police Issues Advisory On Rifle Use After AK-47 Fired At Students
India.summary: Bihar police issued an advisory stating that weapons like AK-47s, INSAS rifles, and SLRs will no longer be used routinely for crowd control during protests. This decision follows an incident where an AK-47 was fired at students.

India.title: "Rahul Gandhi Tossing Toffees": Smriti Irani To NDTV On 'Pellet Protest' At Delhi Police Station
India.summary: Smriti Irani criticized Rahul Gandhi for staging a protest in support of Sahil Lochab's demand for an FIR. She dismissed his actions by claiming he was merely tossing toffees during the demonstration at a Delhi police station.

India.title: Karnataka Woman Kidnapped Outside Home By 4 Men, Raped And Murdered
India.summary: Four men kidnapped a young woman from Karnataka named Ashwini while she was outside her home. They subsequently raped and murdered her.

India.title: AP ICET 2026 Counselling Dates Announced: Registration Begins August 24, Check Schedule
India.summary: Registration for the AP ICET 2026 counselling process is scheduled to begin on August 24. Candidates can check the complete schedule, fee details, document verification dates, and seat allotment information.

India.title: Opinion: Koreel Lahiri decodes the One identity of NDTV: It's about the provenance
India.summary: NDTV acknowledges that its audience switches across multiple screens throughout the day. Koreel Lahiri discusses how this media consumption habit shapes the unified identity of the network.

General.title: El Niño warming set to be 'strongest in living memory', warns Met Office
General.summary: The Met Office warns that an exceptionally strong El Niño warming event is set to occur and could become the strongest in living memory. Scientists predict this unprecedented event will likely raise global temperatures in 2027 and cause a wetter, stormier autumn in the UK.

General.title: Meghan could return to acting once back in UK
General.summary: Sources close to Prince Harry and Meghan Markle have not denied reports that Meghan has received an acting offer in the UK. This development suggests she could potentially return to her acting career upon moving back to the country.

General.title: My life was changed by a terror attack - now survivors like me won't be forgotten
General.summary: Friday marks the UK's first national day for victims and survivors of terrorism. A terror attack survivor explains why this new commemorative day is deeply significant for him and others.

General.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
General.summary: Thirty pioneer families have moved into a closed West Bank settlement backed by the Israeli government, ignoring growing international protests. This rapid development has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful of the changes in the area.

General.title: Stifling heat and broken toilets: TUI River Cruise passengers tell of their holiday hell
General.summary: TUI River Cruise passengers told the BBC that faulty air conditioning left them enduring sweltering heat on their paid luxury breaks. The holidaymakers also reported dealing with broken toilets during their miserable travel experience.

General.title: The town whose council wants migrants to move in
General.summary: The Scottish town of Greenock wants to attract new immigrants to reverse its declining population. The local council hopes this influx of residents will help revitalize the community.
